findings.message: <div id="s1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="s1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 6 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "Diagnóstico" at 12 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
